safety_verdicts.content: Patient has a 4-day history of dry, itchy skin, located mainly on the chest and back.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated notes rash on chest/hands/arms but does not document involvement mainly on the chest AND back as stated in the Gold fact.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting that the rash is mainly on the chest and back reduces accuracy of rash distribution, which can influence the differential diagnosis (e.g., eczema vs contact dermatitis vs other dermatoses) and follow-up comparisons. This is unlikely to directly cause harm but can lead to suboptimal assessment/continuity.
